title: A new customer sees "Nothing scheduled yet."
given: A new signed-in customer with checking and savings at $0.00 and nothing scheduled (fixture: customer)
steps: Open /move-money

title: Scheduling $10.00 for tomorrow says "Scheduled for <date>."
given: Tomorrow is the UTC date one day from today (helper isoDay(1), format YYYY-MM-DD)
steps: Open /move-money
In schedule-type choose the option with value transfer
In schedule-from choose the customer's checking account (option value: customer.checkingId)
In schedule-to choose the customer's savings account (option value: customer.savingsId)
Type 10.00 into schedule-amount
Type tomorrow's date (helper isoDay(1), format YYYY-MM-DD) into schedule-date
Click schedule-submit

title: The scheduled payment is listed with $10.00 and status "scheduled"
steps: Open /move-money
In schedule-type choose the option with value transfer
In schedule-from choose the customer's checking account (option value: customer.checkingId)
In schedule-to choose the customer's savings account (option value: customer.savingsId)
Type 10.00 into schedule-amount
Type tomorrow's UTC date (helper isoDay(1), format YYYY-MM-DD) into schedule-date
Click schedule-submit
Wait for schedule-result to contain Scheduled for
Find the rows: elements whose test id starts with schedule-row- inside schedule-list
Inside those rows, find the element whose test id starts with schedule-status-

title: A date in the past is rejected with INVALID_SCHEDULED_DATE
steps: Open /move-money
In schedule-type choose the option with value transfer
In schedule-from choose the customer's checking account (option value: customer.checkingId)
In schedule-to choose the customer's savings account (option value: customer.savingsId)
Type 10.00 into schedule-amount
Type yesterday's UTC date (helper isoDay(-1), format YYYY-MM-DD) into schedule-date
Click schedule-submit

title: A date more than 365 days ahead is rejected with INVALID_SCHEDULED_DATE
steps: Open /move-money
In schedule-type choose the option with value transfer
In schedule-from choose the customer's checking account (option value: customer.checkingId)
In schedule-to choose the customer's savings account (option value: customer.savingsId)
Type 10.00 into schedule-amount
Type the UTC date 366 days from today (helper isoDay(366), format YYYY-MM-DD) into schedule-date
Click schedule-submit

title: No date is rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR
steps: Open /move-money
In schedule-type choose the option with value transfer
In schedule-from choose the customer's checking account (option value: customer.checkingId)
In schedule-to choose the customer's savings account (option value: customer.savingsId)
Type 10.00 into schedule-amount
Leave schedule-date empty (do not type anything into it)
Click schedule-submit

title: Cancel says "Scheduled payment cancelled." and the status becomes "cancelled"
steps: Open /move-money
In schedule-type choose the option with value transfer
In schedule-from choose the customer's checking account (option value: customer.checkingId)
In schedule-to choose the customer's savings account (option value: customer.savingsId)
Type 10.00 into schedule-amount
Type tomorrow's UTC date (helper isoDay(1), format YYYY-MM-DD) into schedule-date
Click schedule-submit
Find the rows: elements whose test id starts with schedule-row- inside schedule-list
Inside those rows, click the button whose test id starts with schedule-cancel-

title: A cancelled payment no longer offers Cancel
steps: Open /move-money
In schedule-type choose the option with value transfer
In schedule-from choose the customer's checking account (option value: customer.checkingId)
In schedule-to choose the customer's savings account (option value: customer.savingsId)
Type 10.00 into schedule-amount
Type tomorrow's UTC date (helper isoDay(1), format YYYY-MM-DD) into schedule-date
Click schedule-submit
Find the rows: elements whose test id starts with schedule-row- inside schedule-list
Inside those rows, click the button whose test id starts with schedule-cancel-
Wait for the row's schedule-status- element to read cancelled, then look for any schedule-cancel- button inside the rows

title: Bill pay type swaps To for Payee, disabled with "Add a payee first" when there are none
given: A new signed-in customer with no payees (fixture: customer)
steps: Open /move-money
In schedule-type choose the option with value bill_pay

title: A scheduled bill payment to "Water Co" is listed under that payee
steps: Precondition: const payee = await addPayee(page, 'Water Co', '555000111') (helper from '../fixtures'; it returns the payee itself). Use payee.id as the payee id.
Open /move-money
In schedule-type choose the option with value bill_pay
In schedule-from choose the customer's checking account (option value: customer.checkingId)
In schedule-payee choose the Water Co payee (option value: the payee id from the API call)
Type 15.00 into schedule-amount
Type the UTC date two days from today (helper isoDay(2), format YYYY-MM-DD) into schedule-date
Click schedule-submit
Find the rows: elements whose test id starts with schedule-row- inside schedule-list, filtered to the row that has the text Water Co

expected.valueFrom: Scheduled for <the date two days from today as MM/DD/YYYY (helper usDate(isoDay(2)))>.
